answer_1.quote: We aim to learn a generative language model that can produce news content characteristic of news sources of varied credibility... We propose multiple variations of encoder-decoder models that learn a function that transforms tweets from deceptive news sources to the style of credible news sources...
datasets: Twitter news source dataset (319K deceptive tweets, 1M credible tweets)
answer_1.outputs: Generated tweets conditioned on news source type and/or named entities; translated tweets between deceptive and credible styles

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performance of the models... BLEU scores of both real and generated tweets... To evaluate the translation task, we rely on a set of metrics used to evaluate machine translation and text generation systems: BLEU, iBLEU, FK-BLEU, SARI, and GLEU.
